description.narrative: COOP is considered a good partner for FMO given their unique focus on cooperatives and agriculture clients as well as their strong interest in promoting sustainable banking and agriculture practices. In addition, the bank is seen as one of the most innovative in the market, having launched the sector’s first digital lending app and alternative banking channels (mobile money and agency networks), and is one of the only banks in the country to be actively lending to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and the agriculture sector with the bank operating primarily through rural branches and also employing circa 90 agronomists to provide capacity building and advisory support to their clients.
